banner.title: Trial deployment
banner.body: Deployed to try the template. Keep it as a permanent app, or stop and delete it once you're done. Until then it keeps running like any other app.

dialog.title: Keep {{name}} as a permanent app
dialog.description: It stops being flagged as a throwaway trial and shows like every other app, with every service of the same app. Nothing restarts and nothing is deleted.
dialog.checklistTitle: What a permanent app should have
dialog.checklistHint: Set these up now or later; each opens the screen that does it.
